name: South Ayrshire
title: South Ayrshire —
tagline: The birthplace of Robert Burns, Culzean Castle and some of the world's finest golf.
summary: South Ayrshire is Burns Country. The poet was born in Alloway in 1759, and the Burns Birthplace Museum, the cottage, the Brig o' Doon and Burns Monument are all here.
The coast has Culzean Castle, golf at Turnberry and Troon, and the sandy beaches of Ayr and Prestwick.
